digest.en: Israel sent a laser weapon system called 'Iron Beam' to the UAE to counter Iranian drones. The US and Iran are engaged in stalled talks as the world's largest aircraft carrier left the Persian Gulf. Gas prices surged $4.39 per gallon in a significant one-day jump.
digest.hi: अमेरिका-ईरान संघर्ष में नया विवाद गहरा रहा है। अराघची ने पेंटागन पर युद्ध की लागत कम आंकने का आरोप लगाया। ईरान के इस कदम से मध्य पूर्व में तनाव बढ़ रहा है।

articles.title: Israel Sent UAE Laser Weapon Called 'Iron Beam' That Can Vapourise Iranian Drones
articles.summary: Israel sent the UAE a laser weapon called Iron Beam to counter Iranian drones. The report stated that the offensive and defensive systems sent to the UAE were mostly prototypes.

articles.title: World's Largest Aircraft Carrier Leaves Persian Gulf As US-Iran Talks Stall
articles.summary: The world's largest aircraft carrier left the Persian Gulf as US-Iran talks stalled. The Ford is currently in the US European Command area of responsibility. (File). World's Largest Aircraft Carrier Leaves Persian Gulf As US-Iran Talks Stall.

articles.title: Cricket club bans social media comments to protect players’ mental health
articles.summary: Kent cricket club banned social media comments to protect players' mental health. English basement county, Kent, are led by former international Adam Hollioake, who is concerned for players' well being.

articles.title: US imposes sanctions on DR Congo ex-President Kabila alleging rebel support
articles.summary: The US imposed sanctions on former DR Congo President Kabila for allegedly supporting rebels. The former leader has not responded to US accusations that he is aiming to destabilise the government.

articles.title: Iran Delivers New Proposal To Pakistan For US Peace Talks: Report
articles.summary: Iran delivered a new proposal to Pakistan for US peace talks after previous talks failed. Iran and US negotiators have met in Pakistan only once, but the talks had failed at the time.

articles.title: Gas prices hit $4.39 per gallon in biggest one-day jump since Iran ceasefire announced
articles.summary: Gas prices jumped to $4.39 per gallon in the biggest one-day increase since the Iran ceasefire. Gas prices hit $4.39 per gallon in biggest one-day jump since Iran ceasefire announced NBC News.

articles.title: Pentagon Signs Deals With 7 AI Companies, Anthropic Not On List
articles.summary: The Pentagon signed deals with 7 AI companies, excluding Anthropic, deemed a supply-chain risk. The Pentagon agreement comes weeks after it designated Antrhopic as a supply-chain risk. (File). Pentagon Signs Deals With 7 AI Companies, Anthropic Not On List.

articles.title: Arteta urges Arsenal to focus on Premier League title push ahead of Fulham clash
articles.summary: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta has urged his team to focus on the Premier League title ahead of their match against Fulham. The Gunners are currently fifth in the league table, seven points behind leaders Manchester City.

articles.title: Chelsea's Champions League hopes fading as McFarlane calls for final push
articles.summary: Chelsea's Champions League hopes are dwindling, with the team now six points behind fourth-placed Tottenham. The club's director, Eugene McFarlane, has called for a final push to salvage their season.

articles.title: Howe says Saudi owners’ desire for success at Newcastle remains unchanged
articles.summary: Newcastle United's Saudi owners remain committed to success, according to manager Eddie Howe. This comes after the Public Investment Fund announced it would cut funding for LIV Golf at the end of the 2026 season.

articles.title: How Indigenous Acknowledgments Became a Target in Australia
articles.summary: The Australian government is facing opposition to the practice of Indigenous Acknowledgments at public events. The right-wing party has taken aim at the practice, which has become standard at most public events.

articles.title: Woman killed, children injured as Israel attacks Lebanon
articles.summary: Israel attacked Lebanon, killing a woman and injuring children, despite a US-brokered ceasefire. Israel's assault, which has displaced more than one people in Lebanon, escalates despite US brokered 'ceasefire'. Woman killed, children injured as Israel attacks Lebanon.

articles.title: 'Don't Accept Imposition, Don't Want War': Iran Says Open To Talk To US
articles.summary: Iran is open to talks with the US after stalled negotiations and a naval blockade. Talks have since stalled as the United States imposed a naval blockade on Iranian ports.

articles.title: ‘Turbulent and dangerous’: How shipping is the new global battleground
articles.summary: Geopolitics is changing global shipping rules from Hormuz to the South China Sea. From Hormuz to Panama, the South China Sea to the Black Sea, geopolitics is rewriting the rules of global shipping.

articles.title: War in Iran Is Making the Hajj, the Muslim Pilgrimage, More Expensive
articles.summary: India has increased hajj package prices for its citizens due to soaring jet fuel prices stemming from the war in Iran. The government has been forced to hike prices to offset the rising costs of transporting pilgrims to the Hajj.

articles.title: Iran Crisis Making Delivery Of Relief Aid To Refugees Costly : UN Agency
articles.summary: Aid shipments detour around Africa's Cape of Good Hope due to the Iran crisis. Aid shipments now detour around Africa's Cape of Good Hope, increasing transit times. Iran Crisis Making Delivery Of Relief Aid To Refugees Costly: UN Agency.

articles.title: Iran Delivers New Proposal For Talks With US Via Pakistan
articles.summary: The US received a new proposal for talks with Iran via Pakistan, marking a potential shift in diplomatic efforts. The proposal's details remain unclear, but it suggests a willingness to engage in negotiations.

articles.title: Giorgia Meloni’s moral retreat on Gaza
articles.summary: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni responded to Israel's war on Gaza with calculated politics. The Italian PM’s response to Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza reflects not moral conviction, but political calculation.

articles.title: Greek Orthodox Church sounds alarm over attacks on Christians in Jerusalem
articles.summary: A Jewish man was arrested for attacking a nun in Jerusalem, prompting a warning from the Greek Orthodox Church. Warning follows Jewish man's arrest over brutal attack on nun in Jerusalem this week.

articles.title: Oscar Statuette For 'Mr. Nobody Against Putin' Goes Missing On Flight
articles.summary: Russian filmmaker Talankin's Oscar statuette went missing on a flight after he co-directed a documentary on pro-war messaging. Talankin fled Russia in 2024 and co-directed a documentary on pro-war messaging in schools.

articles.title: Strain on food, fuel and aid systems continues
articles.summary: The Middle East crisis strains global food, fuel, and aid systems. The strain on food, fuel and aid systems worldwide continues as the the Middle East crisis deepens. Rising oil prices, supply disruptions and mounting transport costs are affecting humanitarian operations and access to essential goods far beyond the region.
